headline: Tesla Q2 2026 deliveries due today (Jul 2) — TSLA pre-market +1.07% at $429.87 ahead of report; analyst range 396,500–420,000 vs 406,024 consensus; beat above 413K would mark Tesla's first clear YoY delivery acceleration since 2023; Michael Burry discloses short positions against TSLA, Nvidia, and Caterpillar warning of AI bubble; Cantor Fitzgerald targets 397K below consensus; Giga Texas 'significant announcement' July 7 adds to near-term catalyst stack; Q2 earnings report July 22 (TipRanks / CNBC / Yahoo Finance, Jul 2, 2026)

Tesla production vehicles now autonomously drive themselves through final factory quality checks — internal microphone arrays detect squeaks and rattles while cars self-navigate through inspection stations at Giga Texas without human drivers; Lars Moravy simultaneously confirms 'significant announcement' on Giga Texas production scaling for July 7 event; autonomous factory QC signals Tesla FSD intelligence now embedded in manufacturing efficiency; Moravy also revealed Optimus production line uses modular architecture adaptable as robot hardware evolves — dozens of lines planned (notateslaapp / Teslarati, Jul 2, 2026)

Elon Musk walks Optimus production line at Fremont — VP Lars Moravy confirms modular, rapidly scalable line design; 'Walking the Optimus production line in Fremont' post garnered nearly 1M views; Moravy confirms dozens of lines planned, modular architecture means Tesla won't need to overhaul manufacturing each time the robot's design changes; volume production start still targeted late July / August 2026 per Q1 earnings call (Musk on X / basenor / SawyerMerritt on X, Jul 1, 2026)

Tesla Q2 deliveries due July 2 — maximum analyst divergence: Goldman (420K), JPMorgan (420K), Barclays (418K), Deutsche Bank (416K) all above IR consensus (406K); Cantor Fitzgerald projects miss at 397K; Bloomberg consensus 396K (20 analysts); Europe + international sales cited as primary upside driver; a beat above 413K would be Tesla's first clear YoY delivery acceleration since 2023; Q2 earnings report follows July 22 (Deutsche Bank / Bloomberg / Cantor / Yahoo Finance, Jul 1, 2026)
source: Deutsche Bank / Goldman Sachs / Bloomberg / Yahoo Finance

headline: BYD set to crush Tesla in Q2 2026 with ~557,000 BEV deliveries — Electrek: 'BYD has now outsold Tesla in Europe'; Tesla EU registrations continue to slide; TSLA still dominant in US but global market share narrative shifting; BYD's pure-BEV tally (~557K) expected to be ~37% above Tesla's projected Q2 deliveries (~406K consensus); Tesla's competitive moat increasingly reliant on autonomy/AI premium rather than volume leadership (Electrek, Jul 1, 2026)

Tesla settles another FSD crash lawsuit; NHTSA finds system 'did not detect common roadway conditions that impaired camera visibility' until immediately before crash — settlement terms undisclosed; regulator language signals EA26002 (3.2M-vehicle probe) advancing toward formal findings; Business Insider deep-dive on missing crash data published same day; continued FSD litigation exposure into Q2 earnings (Claims Journal / Business Insider / The Star, Jul 1, 2026)

Tesla begins first public-road engineering tests of production Cybercab WITHOUT steering wheel, pedals, or any human controls in Austin — @Tesla official X account posted video of unit navigating Austin traffic autonomously; safety monitor in passenger seat only during testing phase; hundreds of Cybercabs simultaneously shipping to Dallas and Houston hubs; Tesla VP Lars Moravy teases 'big announcement' at Giga Texas July 7 with sources pointing to Cybercab production scaling or mid-July Houston commercial launch (@Tesla on X / notateslaapp / basenor, Jun 30, 2026)

Texas regulatory stack for Cybercab commercial deployment now essentially complete — Tesla self-certified commercial robotaxi software as SAE Level 4 under Texas state law (May 28); Cybercab officially listed in Texas DPS Connected AV First Responder Interaction Plan registry; official Cybercab emergency handbook classifies it as 'completely driverless' with SAE Level 4 Autonomous Mode; combined with NHTSA brake pedal removal (Jun 24) and statewide TX AV Registry entry, Tesla has cleared all major regulatory gates for large-scale Cybercab commercial service in Texas (notateslaapp / basenor / Texas DPS, Jun 29-30, 2026)

FSD v14 Lite HW3 first impressions overwhelmingly positive — early access users reporting zero interventions on complex routes (Culver City to Hollywood); Electrek confirms RL improvements, parking/unparking, pedestrian interactions, and navigation handling all translate well via model distillation from HW4; 'distilled the intelligence from HW4 V14 into HW3' per release notes; 2026.20.5.1 release notes also add Robotaxi-style drop-off arrival options; broader rollout to more HW3 customers over coming weeks pending validation (notateslaapp / Electrek / basenor, Jun 29, 2026)
